card.name: QT correction formula names and nearby links
card.fires_on: The first piece of Fridericia's or Framingham (QTc correction formulas) after QTc/QT interval, and small linking words like "to", "as" or "e.g.," in QTc thresholds and antiarrhythmic drug lists.

modes.label: Formula names
modes.description: The start of Framingham or Fridericia right after a QT correction phrase.

modes.label: Threshold wording
modes.description: The word "to" in "greater than or equal to" a QTc value in msec.
